scope: Bounded composition of retained native PP method CALs with the retained one-through-six-bridge point-to-point route and Reply Network correlation; scripted acceptance only

retained_native_evidence.finding: Retains native direct, paged/NCC, OEM memory, GIU/SGIU/DALI and GOC/GOCBYT/GOC2 programming-method order and block limits.
Original receiver correlation accepts Reply Network paths through one to six bridges and rejects route, unit and CAL mismatches.
Retains the exact-once routed Unlock, STORE acknowledgement and complete readback composition.

cmqttd_acceptance: Transport tests pin one- and six-bridge selector, page, tagged STORE and recall bytes for OEM, GOC2 and page-aware methods.
Direct, neighbouring-route, wrong-unit, wrong-parameter and wrong-tag replies cannot advance routed OEM programming.
Every stateful selector and STORE is issued once; incomplete correlation retires the programming generation without replay.
The C-Gate service test executes a page-aware routed PP SAVE and commits only the owned target-network session after verified readback.
CMQTT CAPABILITIES exposes every admitted routed method and routed Save-to-NVM completion boundary.
evidence_boundaries: No live bridge or routed unit was modified for this acceptance.
Successful protocol acknowledgement and readback do not establish power-cycle persistence or every device-family firmware behavior.
Routed C-Bus 3 Save-to-NVM extended-CAL composition is covered by native_cgate_routed_nvm_commit.json; live bridge delivery and power-cycle durability remain unverified.
